brief.question: Build an original desktop music-streaming-style app (Spotify-like features) with no ads and a sign-in account, in Rust + egui.
brief.purpose: Person wants their own ad-free music app with accounts.
constraints: No copying of brand names, logos or artwork
brief.done_when: cargo build succeeds, --screenshot works, rebuild_check passes; app has sign up/sign in, library, search, playlists, liked songs, real audio playback with no ads.

plan.title: Add sign up and sign in
Make the music library, search and playlists
